emails.subject: you made it to friday
emails.preview_text: A small reminder for the end of the week.
emails.intro: Hey, you got through another week.
emails.affirmation: You don't have to have done everything to have done enough.
emails.reflection: Whatever this week looked like, let the weekend meet you where you are.

emails.subject: permission to go slow today
emails.preview_text: Nothing on today's list is more important than you.
emails.affirmation: You are allowed to rest before you're exhausted.
emails.reflection: Rest isn't a reward you earn. It's something you need, and today is a good day for it.

emails.subject: a gentle one for sunday
emails.preview_text: Before the new week starts, read this.
emails.affirmation: Next week doesn't need to be handled today.
emails.reflection: Let today be today. You can meet Monday when it gets here.

emails.subject: for the start of the week
emails.preview_text: One kind thought to carry into Monday.
emails.affirmation: You can do hard things, one small piece at a time.
emails.reflection: You don't need to see the whole week clearly. Just the next step.

emails.subject: you're not behind
emails.preview_text: A reminder that your timeline is yours.
emails.affirmation: You're not behind. You're on your own timeline.
emails.reflection: Other people's progress isn't a measure of yours. You're moving, even when it's quiet.

emails.subject: for the middle of the week
emails.preview_text: Halfway there, and doing better than you think.
emails.affirmation: You're doing better than you think you are.
emails.reflection: The parts of you that keep showing up deserve some credit today.

emails.subject: hello, october
emails.preview_text: A fresh month and a fresh page.
emails.affirmation: You get to begin again, as many times as you need.
emails.reflection: Nothing from last month has to come with you unless you want it to.

emails.subject: your feelings make sense
emails.preview_text: Whatever you're feeling today is allowed.
emails.affirmation: Your feelings are valid, even the ones you can't explain yet.
emails.reflection: You don't have to justify how you feel before you're allowed to feel it.

emails.subject: a slow saturday thought
emails.preview_text: Something to sit with over your morning coffee.
emails.affirmation: You are worthy of quiet moments that ask nothing of you.
emails.reflection: If you can, find ten minutes today that belong only to you.

emails.subject: you are enough, today too
emails.preview_text: No conditions, no small print.
emails.affirmation: You are enough, exactly as you are right now.
emails.reflection: Not after the next goal. Not once you've fixed something. Right now.

emails.subject: one step is still a step
emails.preview_text: For a Monday that feels like a lot.
emails.affirmation: Small steps still move you forward.
emails.reflection: Progress doesn't have to be big to be real. Today, one step counts.

emails.subject: it's okay to ask
emails.preview_text: A reminder you might need this week.
emails.affirmation: Asking for help is a sign of strength, not weakness.
emails.reflection: Letting someone in on what you're carrying makes it lighter for both of you.

emails.subject: the kindness you give
emails.preview_text: You deserve some of it back.
emails.affirmation: You deserve the same kindness you give so freely to others.
emails.reflection: Try speaking to yourself today the way you'd speak to someone you love.

emails.subject: healing takes its own path
emails.preview_text: For the days that feel like a step back.
emails.affirmation: Healing isn't a straight line, and that's okay.
emails.reflection: A hard day doesn't erase the good ones that came before it.

emails.subject: you showed up this week
emails.preview_text: Friday is here, and so are you.
emails.affirmation: Showing up, even on the hard days, is its own kind of strength.
emails.reflection: Whatever you managed this week, it counts.

emails.subject: for world mental health day
emails.preview_text: Today is about taking care of the mind you live in.
emails.intro: Today is World Mental Health Day.
emails.affirmation: Your mental health matters, and taking care of it is never selfish.
emails.reflection: If today feels heavy, you don't have to carry it alone. Reaching out to someone you trust is a good place to start.

emails.subject: nothing to prove today
emails.preview_text: A quiet one for Sunday.
emails.affirmation: Your worth was never something you had to earn.
emails.reflection: You were worthy before you did anything today, and you still will be tonight.

emails.subject: start where you are
emails.preview_text: You don't need a perfect Monday.
emails.affirmation: You can start from exactly where you are.
emails.reflection: You don't need to feel ready. Starting is what makes you ready.

emails.subject: your pace is fine
emails.preview_text: A reminder to breathe.
emails.affirmation: Breathe. You're exactly where you need to be right now.
emails.reflection: Take one slow breath before you open anything else today.

emails.subject: you matter more than you know
emails.preview_text: Some things are worth hearing twice.
emails.affirmation: Your presence makes a difference, even when you can't see it.
emails.reflection: The people around you are better for having you in their day.

emails.subject: permission to say no
emails.preview_text: Protecting your energy is allowed.
emails.affirmation: It's okay to say no to things that drain you.
emails.reflection: Every no to something that costs too much is a yes to yourself.

emails.subject: the week is almost done
emails.preview_text: A soft landing for Friday.
emails.affirmation: Not every week has to be productive to be a good one.
emails.reflection: Sometimes getting through is the win. Let that be enough this weekend.

emails.subject: little joys still count
emails.preview_text: For a slow Saturday morning.
emails.affirmation: Small moments of joy are still worth celebrating.
emails.reflection: A good song, a warm drink, a quiet minute. Let yourself enjoy them fully.

emails.subject: you can set it down
emails.preview_text: Some things aren't yours to carry.
emails.affirmation: You don't have to carry what was never yours to hold.
emails.reflection: If something's been weighing on you, ask gently whether it really belongs to you.

emails.subject: you're growing
emails.preview_text: Even when it doesn't feel like it.
emails.affirmation: You're growing, even when it feels like you're standing still.
emails.reflection: Roots grow before anything shows above the ground.

emails.subject: be gentle with yourself
emails.preview_text: A reminder for a busy Tuesday.
emails.affirmation: Being gentle with yourself is not the same as giving up.
emails.reflection: You can hold high hopes for yourself and still be kind along the way.

emails.subject: both things can be true
emails.preview_text: Hope and worry can sit side by side.
emails.affirmation: You can feel worried and still be hopeful.
emails.reflection: You don't have to choose one feeling. There's room for both today.

emails.subject: you've gotten through before
emails.preview_text: A reminder of what you're capable of.
emails.affirmation: You've made it through hard days before, and you can make it through this one.
emails.reflection: Look back at what you've already handled. That strength is still yours.

emails.subject: mistakes mean you tried
emails.preview_text: For anything that didn't go right this week.
emails.affirmation: Mistakes don't make you a failure. They mean you were brave enough to try.
emails.reflection: Take what you learned and leave the rest behind.

emails.subject: a day that asks nothing
emails.preview_text: Saturday doesn't need a plan.
emails.affirmation: Today doesn't have to be perfect to be good.
emails.reflection: Let the day be simple, and let simple be enough.

emails.subject: the world is better with you
emails.preview_text: A Sunday reminder.
emails.affirmation: The world is better because you're in it.
emails.reflection: There are small good things that happen only because you're here.

emails.subject: your needs matter
emails.preview_text: Start the week by listening to yourself.
emails.affirmation: Your needs are not too much.
emails.reflection: Needing rest, support or space doesn't make you a burden. It makes you human.

emails.subject: you are more than your to-do list
emails.preview_text: A reminder for a full day.
emails.affirmation: Your value isn't measured by how much you get done.
emails.reflection: You matter on the productive days and on the quiet ones too.

emails.subject: this feeling won't last forever
emails.preview_text: For anything that feels heavy right now.
emails.affirmation: What you're feeling right now is real, and it won't last forever.
emails.reflection: Feelings move like weather. Clearer days come back.

emails.subject: you're allowed to change
emails.preview_text: A reminder you can outgrow things.
emails.affirmation: It's okay to outgrow things that once fit you.
emails.reflection: Changing your mind or your path is a sign you're paying attention to yourself.

emails.subject: proud of how far you've come
emails.preview_text: Look back before you look ahead.
emails.affirmation: Be proud of how far you've come.
emails.reflection: Remember what used to feel impossible. You're past some of it now.

emails.subject: happy halloween
emails.preview_text: No mask needed for this one.
emails.affirmation: The real you is more than enough, no costume required.
emails.reflection: Enjoy the treats today, and let yourself be exactly who you are.
